assumptions: For smooth real divergence-free unforced 2D Navier–Stokes flow on (R/2pi Z)^2 with normalized area, viscosity nu>0 and initial L2 velocity norm <=E, the supplied information is the exact square Fourier snapshot P_K u(0), with |j|_infinity<=K including the zero mode, and K,E,nu,T. The output is the entire P_K velocity path on [0,T], measured in supremum-time L2 error; unlimited predictor computation is allowed. For integer K>=16, the source gives 1e-8 E^2 min{K^2 T,1/(nu+E)} <= minimax error <=10 E^2 min{K^2 T,1/(nu+E)}. This is a source-reported full proof with informed internal cross-reconstruction, not an independently verified theorem. An observed nonzero mean is handled by a Galilean frame.

On B_1 in R^n, n>=3, consider real smooth scalar conductivities in [1/2,3/2], equal to one near the boundary, with integer Sobolev index s>n/2. For a supplied smooth axisymmetric bump psi supported inside B_r away from the rotation axis, the source constructs sigma_k^±=1±a k^-s psi(rho,z) cos(k theta). Their calibrated-coordinate L2 separation is sqrt(2) a ||psi||_2 k^-s, but their nonlinear Dirichlet-to-Neumann response difference in the harmonic-energy operator norm is at most C a k^-s r^k. This is an internally reconstructed proof candidate; quantitative separation modulo a gauge is OPEN.

For explicitly supplied affine equations a_e dot x=b_e over F_2 and independent exact rational retention probabilities p_e, U is the probability the retained equations are inconsistent. The source supplies complete elementary reductions showing that an FPRAS for distinct fair-retained equations of arity at most three would yield an FPRAS for #BIS, conditional on the stated Feng–Fu–Guo two-terminal-unreliability theorem. This is an approximation-preserving implication, not unconditional impossibility of an FPRAS. Matrix construction, accuracy/confidence encodings and output bit costs are charged. Empirical probability calibration and justification of independence are outside the supplied computational model.

For the supplied real controlled star i xdot_i=k_i conjugate(y_i)c, i ydot_i=k_i conjugate(x_i)c, i cdot=sum_i k_i x_i y_i with k=Kv in R^r and a fixed admitted d-dimensional control span, the source constructs an exact polynomial state for every modal action, including amplitude-zero strata. Set a=|x|^2, e=|y|^2, n=|c|^2, b_i=x_i y_i, s=a+e, p_i=Im(b_i conjugate(c)), S_ij=Re(b_i conjugate(b_j)), R=SK, P=K^T p and L=K^T(k elementwise s). Then adot=edot=-2k elementwise p, ndot=2k^T p, pdot=Rv-k elementwise s n, and Rdot_i,alpha=-k_i s_i P_alpha-L_alpha p_i. Storage and derivative work are O(rd+r), with supplied dense K already costing rd entries. No division by amplitudes is used.
